headline: Google News filtering problems raise healthcare information discovery concerns
body: Google News is facing criticism for its inability to surface relevant articles, according to recent coverage across tech platforms. For healthcare organizations relying on Google's news aggregation to monitor clinical guidelines, regulatory updates, and vendor announcements, poor filtering creates friction in staying current. Healthcare AI teams need reliable information feeds to track EHR integrations, compliance changes, and competitive vendor moves. This signals a need for healthcare IT leaders to diversify information sources rather than depend solely on major search platforms for critical industry intelligence.
